bulk.title: Bulk ingest
bulk.desc: Load many records in one job: upload a file in chunks, close the job, then follow every row. Chunks are checked and stored by the server; sending the same chunk again is safe.
bulk.noJobs: No bulk jobs for the object types you may load.
bulk.objectTypeHint: The kind of record to load. The server checks that you may load it (ops.variable: process variables, tenant administrators).
bulk.expectedChunksHint: Optional. When given, the job closes only after this many chunks.
bulk.positiveWhole: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
bulk.uploadHint: CSV needs an externalId column; the other columns become the row data. JSON is an array of {externalId, data}; NDJSON is one such object per line. Rows are sent in chunks, in file order, starting after the chunks already received.
bulk.parseErrors: {{n}} entries could not be read and will not be sent:
bulk.oversize: {{n}} rows are larger than the byte limit by themselves, for example {{ids}}. Shorten them or raise the limit.
bulk.duplicates: {{n}} externalIds appear more than once, for example {{ids}}. Each occurrence becomes its own row.
bulk.tooManyChunks: This job expects {{n}} chunks in total; the file needs more. Raise the rows per chunk or split the file.
bulk.quotaExceeded: This chunk is larger than the tenant's batch-size quota: {{allowed}} rows allowed, {{requested}} sent. Set the rows per chunk to {{allowed}} or fewer and send again; chunks already received are not sent twice.
bulk.limitExceeded: The server refused the chunk as too large: {{detail}}. Lower the rows or bytes per chunk and send again.
bulk.notOpen: Uploads are possible only while the job is open.
bulk.closeHint: No more chunks can be added. The server then processes every row.
bulk.abortHint: Rows not yet processed are cancelled. This cannot be undone.
